nodes.name: GitHub Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives check_suite events from GitHub when CI runs complete.

nodes.name: Is Failure?
nodes.notes: Only proceed if the check suite concluded with failure.

nodes.name: Wait for GitHub Index
nodes.notes: Wait 5 seconds for GitHub to index the workflow run status before querying the runs API.

nodes.name: Find Workflow Runs
nodes.notes: Finds failed GitHub Actions runs by commit SHA (check_suite.id != run_id).

nodes.name: Extract Run Info
nodes.notes: Extracts failed run ID, determines comment target (PR number or issue number from {prefix}/#N-... branch name).

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ body: '> 🤖 **This is an automated message from the DevLLMOps AI Agent**

**Investigating CI failure on branch `' + $json.branch + '`.**

<details>
<summary>View details</summary>

- **Workflow run:** ' + $json.run_name + '
- **Branch:** `' + $json.branch + '`
- **Run URL:** ' + $json.run_url + '

Retrieving failure logs and running AI diagnosis...

</details>' }) }}

nodes.name: Post Starting Comment
nodes.notes: Posts initial comment acknowledging the CI failure investigation has started.

nodes.name: Get Failed Jobs
nodes.notes: Retrieves all jobs for the failed workflow run.

nodes.name: Extract Failed Job
nodes.notes: Finds the first failed job, builds a step-by-step summary with pass/fail indicators.

nodes.name: Get Log Redirect URL
nodes.notes: Requests the log download URL without following the 302 redirect. GitHub returns a signed URL that rejects auth headers if forwarded.

nodes.name: Extract Log URL
nodes.notes: Extracts the Location header (signed log download URL) from the 302 response. Falls back to step summary if unavailable.

nodes.name: Download Logs
nodes.notes: Downloads the actual logs from the signed URL WITHOUT auth headers. Timeout 60s for large logs.

nodes.name: Build Claude Body
nodes.notes: Builds the Anthropic API request safely in JS. Includes step summary and logs (truncated to 30K). Asks for SUMMARY + detailed format.

nodes.name: Claude Diagnosis
nodes.notes: Calls Claude Sonnet for CI failure diagnosis. Timeout 120s, retries 3x with 5s backoff.

nodes.name: Build Analysis Comment
nodes.notes: Parses Claude's SUMMARY/details format. Builds comment with AI header, bold summary, and collapsed full analysis.

nodes.name: Post Analysis Comment
nodes.notes: Posts the final CI failure analysis comment on the PR or linked issue.

nodes.name: Parse Auto-Fix
nodes.notes: Extracts AUTO_FIX_FILE, AUTO_FIX_OLD, AUTO_FIX_NEW markers from Claude response. Sets has_fix flag.

nodes.name: Has Fix?
nodes.notes: Proceeds only if Claude provided an auto-fix AND this is not already an auto-fix commit (loop prevention).

nodes.name: Get File Content
nodes.notes: Fetches the target file from GitHub (base64 content + SHA needed for the commit).

nodes.name: Apply Fix + Commit Body
nodes.notes: Base64-decodes the file, applies the string replacement, re-encodes, and builds the PUT body with [auto-fix] commit message.

nodes.name: Commit Fix
nodes.notes: Commits the fixed file to the branch via GitHub Contents API.

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('Apply Fix + Commit Body').item.json.repo }}/issues/{{ $('Apply Fix + Commit Body').item.json.comment_target }}/comments
parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ body: '> 🤖 **This is an automated message from the DevLLMOps AI Agent**

**Auto-fix committed to branch `' + $('Apply Fix + Commit Body').item.json.branch + '`:** `' + $('Apply Fix + Commit Body').item.json.message + '`

<details>
<summary>View fix details</summary>

- **File:** `' + $('Apply Fix + Commit Body').item.json.path + '`
- **Branch:** `' + $('Apply Fix + Commit Body').item.json.branch + '`
- **Commit message:** `' + $('Apply Fix + Commit Body').item.json.message + '`

CI will re-run automatically. If this fix is incorrect, revert the commit and apply the fix manually.

</details>' }) }}

nodes.name: Post Fix Comment
nodes.notes: Posts a comment confirming the auto-fix commit with file and branch details.

nodes.name: Extract Branch Info
nodes.notes: Validates conclusion=success, checks branch is not protected (main/release), extracts repo/owner/branch/issue_number.

nodes.name: Should Create PR?
nodes.notes: Proceeds only if the branch is eligible for auto-PR creation.

nodes.name: Check Existing PR
nodes.notes: Checks if an open PR already exists for this branch to avoid duplicates.

nodes.name: Build PR Body
nodes.notes: Checks for existing PRs. Humanizes branch slug into title (e.g. f/#5-add-dark-mode -> Feature: Add Dark Mode (#5)), builds body with AI header + Closes #N.

nodes.name: No PR Yet?
nodes.notes: Proceeds only if no open PR exists for this branch (prevents duplicates).

nodes.name: Create PR
nodes.notes: Creates a pull request targeting main. This triggers WF02 (AI Review) via pull_request.opened webhook.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ body: '> 🤖 **This is an automated message from the DevLLMOps AI Agent**

**Pull request auto-created for branch `' + $('Extract Branch Info').item.json.branch + '`.**

' + $json.html_url + '

This PR will now be reviewed by the AI Review workflow (WF02).' }) }}

nodes.name: Post PR Comment
nodes.notes: Posts comment on linked issue confirming PR creation. Uses neverError for branches without issue numbers.
